machine.name: DRX-90 Personal Multimedia System
overview: The DRX-90 is a terminal-cell multimedia system designed for work, communications, and an unexpectedly durable after-hours software catalog.
Its complete logical display is 100 columns by 36 rows. AfterHours presents games, manuals, scores, studios, and release records through the same machine interface.

manufacturer.name: Reçica Computer Works
profile: Reçica Computer Works designed the DRX-90, publishes selected software, and operates the AfterHours catalog and certification program.
RCW documentation is serious, technically ambitious, proud of compatibility, and occasionally unable to explain its own resident utilities.
manufacturer.brand_statement: COMPATIBILITY IS A FEATURE. UNDOCUMENTED COMPATIBILITY IS ALSO A FEATURE.

ros_help.summary: R/OS operates on a curated virtual filesystem. It does not expose files from the user's computer.
